params.message:
Give a daily digest one more try after a mail transport fault

The connection to smtp.resend.com timed out for one dealer on 22 October 2026;
the round went on, but that dealer had no digest that day. A transport fault
now gets a second try ten seconds later; only when that one fails too is it
reported. Other faults are not retried. Rule R B1-2.17.

Nightwatch: 67
